MEMO DL05

Advanced Semiconductor Mobile Phone Cooler for Gaming Performance

Product Description

The MEMO DL05 is a powerful mobile cooling device designed specifically for gamers who face overheating issues during long gameplay sessions. It uses advanced semiconductor (Peltier-based) cooling technology to instantly reduce device temperature.

With its strong cooling performance, it helps maintain stable FPS and prevents lag caused by thermal throttling. This ensures smooth gameplay in PUBG, Free Fire, Call of Duty Mobile, and other high-performance games.

The DL05 features a durable build with aluminum heat dissipation, RGB lighting effects, and a compact design for easy portability. It operates quietly, making it ideal for uninterrupted gaming or streaming.

Designed with universal compatibility, it supports most smartphones and provides efficient cooling even during charging and heavy usage.

Key Features

  • Semiconductor (Peltier) Cooling Technology
  • Rapid Temperature Reduction Performance
  • Stable FPS for Mobile Gaming
  • RGB Gaming Lighting Effects
  • Silent Low-Noise Operation
  • Type-C Power Input
  • Universal Smartphone Compatibility
  • Lightweight & Portable Design
